item.title: Version 0.21.2
item.description:
SupaSidebar 0.21.2

What’s New

  • Analytics Choice at Setup: Onboarding now asks whether to share usage data, and nothing is sent until you pick.

Improvements

  • AI Chat Text Is Never Collected: The text you type into AI chat is no longer sent anywhere, so its privacy toggle is gone.
  • Redesigned License Window: The license screen matches the onboarding design, scrolls, and keeps the Close button reachable at any size.
  • Wider Spaces Preferences: The Spaces list pane starts wider, remembers the width you drag it to, and matches the other panes.
  • Better French Translations: Corrected wording across settings, the menu bar, and update screens, plus several newly translated options.

Bug Fixes

  • An expired trial now shows as a warning instead of a green success checkmark.
